message.content:
**Battle of Stalingrad (1942–1943)** | Aspect | Details | |--------|---------| | **Main Participants** | • **Soviet Union** – Red Army, commanded by General Fyodor Krasnoshchev (later General Georgy Zhukov) and supported by the 62nd Army, 64th Army, and other Soviet formations.
• **Nazi Germany** – Army Group South, led by Field Marshal Friedrich Kampf (later General Erich von Manstein), with the 6th Army and the 4th Panzer Army as the principal German forces. | | **Location** | The city of **Stalingrad** (now Volgograd) in southwestern Russia, on the western bank of the Volga River. The battle took place in and around the city’s industrial districts, the Volga River, and the surrounding countryside. | The battle is widely regarded as one of the turning points of World War II, with the Soviet victory ending the German advance into the Soviet Union.
